qt: to the Commission Alexander Jungbluth (ESN) Subject:

Between 2014 and 2020, the European Regional Development Fund (ERDF) co-financed the replacement of a grain conveyor and silo system at the Raiffeisen Hunsrück Handelsgesellschaft mbH. The aim was to increase energy efficiency compared to the previous system1. Raiffeisen Hunsrück Handelsgesellschaft mbH is a private company trading in marketable products which operates without any discernible structural weakness. The aid had no publicly documented employment or regional policy impact. 1.
What is the Commission’s assessment of the compatibility thereof with EU competition principles under State aid rules?
What specific selection criteria and assessment of structural relevance for the region did the Commission use to justify the selection of this project?

What mechanisms does the Commission put in place to ensure that ERDF funding is not used for individual in-house investments without clearly demonstrable added value in terms of competitive neutrality?
